units.title: Identifying Household Items
units.description: Learning names of objects commonly found at home.
steps: Look at pictures of common items like a chair, table, and glasses.
Say the names of these items aloud.
Identify which item is used for reading or seeing better (spectacles).

units.title: Basic Action Words
units.description: Understanding simple actions like looking, searching, and finding.
steps: Demonstrate the action of 'searching' for a hidden toy.
Explain that 'looking' is using your eyes to see.
Understand that 'finding' happens when you see what you were searching for.
